decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in any of the external walls of the outbuilding hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8:00am  to 6:00pm on Mondays to Friday and 9 :00am to 1:00pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The outbuilding shall only be used for purposes incidental to the use of the existing house at 2 Moulton Avenue, Hounslow, TW3 4LR and shall not be used as a self-contained residence or for any business purpose.
description: Erection of a single storey outbuilding at the rear garden of the house
